observations: Photo 0 shows a corded rotary hammer drill in a blue plastic carrying case.
The brand 'BOSCH' is visible on the box lid and the tool body.
The box lid is labeled '2KG PROFESSIONAL ROTARY HAMMER'.
A silver badge on the top right of the box lid displays '88V'.
The tool in the case has a black power cord, which is inconsistent with the '88V' battery-style marking on the box.
A watermark 'BESTECH GLOBAL TOOLS' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Hammer drill is a power tool that combines the functions of a drill and an impact hammer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a rotary hammer designed for these functions.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's metal or sticker data plate on the tool body showing a valid serial number and 'Made in' location.
A photo of the tool next to a handwritten note with the current date and the buyer's name.
A video of the tool operating in hammer mode and drilling into a hard surface.

proof_requests: Photo of the tool next to a handwritten note with today's date and your name to prove possession.
Close-up photo of the technical specification plate on the side of the drill.
Video of the drill running and switching between modes.
response.reason: The '88V' marking on the box is a well-known hallmark of counterfeit Bosch tools, as Bosch does not use this voltage designation. Furthermore, the 'BESTECH GLOBAL TOOLS' watermark indicates the photo was taken from a third-party retailer, suggesting the seller does not have the item.
